title: NPDev host definition
description: AUTHORED hosting decisions for one app. Lives beside db.definition.json in the app DEFINITION directory, NOT inside the generated app -- regeneration deletes and re-emits _ops/ wholesale, so anything the user chose must live outside it. Analogue of db.definition.json. Written by `npdev host plan`.

rung.description: 0 private | 1 shared by link | 2 permanent address, own box | 3 external free tier | 4 external paid host

target.description: Target id from scripts/policy/hosting-targets.json. Null for rung 0.

provider.description: Tunnel or proxy provider. Null when the platform owns the edge.

through.description: shared-ingress routes through `npdev monitor ingress` so ONE tunnel fronts every app on the box. Prefer it.

authMode.description: Mirrors npdev.auth.mode. Fail-closed in every profile -- an app with no key refuses to boot.

acknowledged.description: Consequences the user accepted in words. The publish gate blocks until the relevant one is present, and never asks twice.
